description: This file implements a driver for the NXP Multirate Timer (MRT) in Zephyr RTOS, providing functions for timer control, interrupt handling, and device initialization, adhering to the Zephyr counter API.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_stop
methods.description: Stops the specified MRT channel timer by setting its load value to forcibly stop.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_start
methods.description: Starts the specified MRT channel timer with the configured top value.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current timer count value for a channel.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_set_top_value
methods.description: Sets the top value for a channel, handling reset and lateness conditions.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_get_top_value
methods.description: Returns the current top value of a channel.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_get_pending_int
methods.description: Checks for pending interrupts on a channel.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_set_alarm
methods.description: MRT does not support alarms; function returns -ENOTSUP.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_cancel_alarm
methods.description: MRT does not support alarms; function returns -ENOTSUP.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_get_freq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of the timer clock.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_init
methods.description: Initializes the MRT device, enabling clocks and interrupts.

methods.name: nxp_mrt_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling MRT channel interrupts and invoking callbacks.
